observed: Task words +0xD0/+0xD4/+0xD8 point to the mechanism, native camera and HUD. Byte +0xDC is the phase. Signed halfwords +0xDE/+0xE0/+0xE2 hold phase frames, the spawn clock and the random threshold.

The private HUD stores a signed timer at +0x80, sweets count at +0x84 and local player health at +0x88. The timer initializes to 99 seconds, represented by 2970 native frames at thirty ticks per second.

The root creates mechanism entity 0x01AE, whose callback creates platform entity 0x01B1. It also controls robot entity 0x00FB, sweet entity 0x01AD and bomb entity 0x01AC spawning; the robot callback resides in a different native overlay.

During phase 6 the root requests bombs at frame residues 1 and 21 modulo 40. A 120-frame pass requests six bombs; repeated phases and surviving parents can yield more than six live bombs. The bomb callback creates two native explosion children before retiring.

Phase 0 saves a 48-byte native player-statistics block. Phase 9 at tick 10 restores that block, runs the native exit cleanup and records the request for room 0x016D, XYZ (0,7,1), camera 0x0100, setup 0xA0 and option 0 through func_801FA420_5B6330.
